vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.1: A pink watchtower with the teleport stone and the bond vault.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.2: A walled court with a gatehouse and the Trophy Hall: every boss you beat gets a spot there.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.3: A stronghold with two corner towers, a smithy and a kitchen (workshops of the Crafts).
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.4: A fortress with four corner towers, a sewing studio, a brewery and a garden.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.uitleg.5: The Cuddle Castle: a great keep with a hall full of chandeliers, spires and everything.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.niets: You carry nothing the castle still needs.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.gedoneerd: %s brought %s building materials to the castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.gedoneerd_ok: You gave %s building materials to the castle. Thank you!
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.nog_niet: The castle can't grow yet: see /bond kasteel for what's missing.
vadsrijk.gilden.kasteel.gebouwd: The castle has grown into a %s (level %s)!
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.basis: Bond chat, a name badge, a banner and the Watchtower with 1 vault tab
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.rust: Bond rest: time offline fills a rest pool; while it lasts you get %s%% more fighting xp
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.rust2: Bond rest II: the rest pool fills twice as fast and holds twice as much
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.reis: %s%% discount on the luxury travel-map flight
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.tp: Teleport to the castle: every %s minutes
vadsrijk.gilden.perk.goud: A golden frame round your bond name on the ranking
vadsrijk.gilden.taak.klaar: Week task done: %s! +%s bond xp and %s in the treasury.
vadsrijk.gilden.taak.alle: All three week tasks done! Another +%s bond xp.
vadsrijk.gilden.auto_lid: %s has contributed enough and is now a member.
vadsrijk.gilden.opgericht: You founded the Cuddle Bond %s! Your plot with a watchtower is ready in the Bond Valley.
vadsrijk.gilden.toegetreden: Welcome to %s! Type /bond for your bond panel.
vadsrijk.gilden.aangemeld: Your application to %s has been sent. An officer will look at it.
vadsrijk.gilden.verwijderd: %s was removed from the bond by %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.nieuwe_leider: %s is the new leader of the bond!
vadsrijk.gilden.opgeheven: The Cuddle Bond %s has been disbanded.
vadsrijk.gilden.opgeheven_ok: %s has been disbanded. The treasury and building depot went to you.
vadsrijk.gilden.kas_ok: You put %s in the bond treasury.
vadsrijk.gilden.trofee: New trophy in the Trophy Hall: %s!
vadsrijk.gilden.rust.vol: Bond rest: your rest pool now holds %s xp (+50%% fighting xp until it's empty).
vadsrijk.gilden.chat.aan: Bond chat ON: what you type goes to your bond. Start with ! to talk to everyone once.
vadsrijk.gilden.chat.uit: Bond chat OFF: you talk to everyone again.
vadsrijk.gilden.verlaat.zeker: Are you sure you want to leave the bond?
vadsrijk.gilden.ophef.zeker: Are you sure you want to DISBAND the bond? The castle disappears.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.geen_bond: You are not in a Cuddle Bond (with this character).
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.klerk: You can only found a bond at the Bond Clerk in the chancellery of Hoogvads.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.al_in_bond: You are already in a bond.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.te_vroeg: You can found a bond once zone 4 is done, or from level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.naam: A bond name is 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits, spaces and dashes.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.tag: A tag is 2 to 4 letters or digits, like PINK.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.bezet: That name or tag already belongs to another bond.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.werft_niet: That bond isn't recruiting right now.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.min_level: That bond takes members from level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.leider_eerst: First hand the leadership to someone else (/bond leden, ♛).
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.rang_hoog: You can only do that to someone of a lower rank.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.bank_vol: Empty the bond vault first: nothing may ever get lost.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.geen_kasteel: You don't have a castle yet.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.rijk: That only works in the Vadsrijk.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.stad: You can teleport to your castle from any town (Knuffelkamp, Zwamzoet, Kandijkom, Honingtak, Lampionhaven, Hoogvads).
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.steen: Touch the teleport stone in your castle first.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.geen_terug: There's no place to go back to.
vadsrijk.gilden.fout.hub_dicht: You haven't been there yet (follow the story).
vadsrijk.gilden.tp.wacht: The teleport stone is resting for %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.tp.plein: To the square of the Bond Valley.
vadsrijk.gilden.tp.terug: Back to where you came from.
vadsrijk.gilden.vallei.welkom: Welcome to the Bond Valley! Every Cuddle Bond has a plot here with its own castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.vallei.gevangen: A little cloud caught you and brought you back to the square.
vadsrijk.gilden.bank.info_ja: %s: you may put things in and take them out here
vadsrijk.gilden.bank.info_nee: %s: you may only put things in here
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.geen: You're not in a Cuddle Bond yet (with this character). Apply at a Bond Board in any town, or get invited.
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.taken_uitleg: Each finished task: +%s bond xp and %s in the treasury; all three: another +%s bond xp.
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.perks_uitleg: Bond xp comes by itself: from creatures, bosses, quests, levels and crafts of every member (max 600 per member per day).
vadsrijk.gilden.paneel.bord: Bond Board: bonds looking for members
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.1: A Cuddle Bond is a club of knights who make the Vadsrijk happier together. You can join anywhere: at a Bond Board in any town, or with an invitation.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.2: Founding a bond is only possible here in Hoogvads, at the Bond Clerk. It costs %s and you need zone 4 done, or level %s.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.3: Everything members do (creatures, bosses, quests, crafts) gives bond xp. Bond levels give handy perks, no big stats.
vadsrijk.gilden.uitleg.4: Every bond gets a plot in the Bond Valley with a castle you build up together: from watchtower to Cuddle Castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.bord.leeg: No bond is recruiting right now.
vadsrijk.gilden.bord.zelf: Found a bond yourself? That's possible at the Bond Clerk in Hoogvads.
vadsrijk.gilden.banier.hover: (hover over the name to see the banner)
vadsrijk.gilden.knop.typ: Click: the command is ready in your chat, fill in and press Enter
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.hallo: Good day! I'm Zegeltje, the Bond Clerk. I register new Cuddle Bonds. Stamp on it, done!
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.al: You're already in a bond! One bond per knight, that's the rule.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.te_vroeg: Your own bond? Come back once you've finished zone 4, or at level %s. Joining a bond is possible already!
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.oprichten: Wonderful! A bond costs %s to register. Pick a name and a short tag of 2 to 4 characters, then I'll stamp it in.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.klerk.typ: Found a bond: click here and fill in your tag and name ->
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.poortwachter.hallo: Beyond this gate lies the Bond Valley: every Cuddle Bond has its own castle there. Want to go?
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.pleinwachter.hallo: Welcome to the Bond Valley! I'll take you back to Hoogvads, or to your bond's castle.
vadsrijk.gilden.npc.bord.hallo: Have a look at the Bond Board! Here hang the Cuddle Bonds looking for new members.
vadsrijk.gilden.optie.oprichten: I want to found a bond
vadsrijk.gilden.tip.vallei: The Bond Valley: the gate back to Hoogvads is on the square. Find your castle via /bond, [To our castle].
vadsrijk.gilden.tip.bank: The bond vault belongs to the whole bond. Recruits may only put things in; members may also take from tab 1; officers from every tab.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.1: A little stamp here, a little stamp there!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.2: A bond without a tag is like a guh without ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_klerk.3: I've registered more bonds than there are clouds. Almost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_poortwachter.1: The gate is always open to friends.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_poortwachter.2: Behind it stand the finest castles of the whole Vadsrijk.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.1: Every plot a castle, every castle a bond.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.2: Don't lean over the edge, now!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_pleinwachter.3: The finest castle? You build it together.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_bord_vallei.3: Find a bond here, and friends too.
